standing: TEST-ONLY review data for stage W4 of the A02 package (11 November 2026): the A02 runs with ILLUSTRATIVE carriers added by declared TEST-ONLY treatments, so the gap an approved answer must fill is executable. Every run here is a TEST-ONLY treatment run, never the A02 configuration; every carrier is ILLUSTRATIVE (ours, not knowledge) and lives only in docs/audits/drafts/a02-illustrative. Nothing on the live route or the checked pathway reads this file.
